question: Why can conceptualization still arise even after initiation removes inner personal ignorance?
premises: Initiation can remove inner personal ignorance.
Conceptual formations may still remain in the intellect.
What remains in the intellect can still give rise to conceptualization.
inference: Therefore even after initiation removes inner personal ignorance, conceptualization may still arise because the intellect's residue has not ceased.
plain_english: Even if initiation has dissolved inner personal ignorance, conceptualization may still arise, because what remains in the intellect has not yet come to an end.
